{{Quote|Well, Cheva, when the lights go out, hang on to me and run like crazy, understand?''"<br />"''Yes''"<br />"''And if the captain or I shout drop, you drop down flat. Got that?''"<br />"''I can assure you I have.|Ghez Hokan to Cheva|<ref name="HC" />}}
'''Cheva''' was a [[Gender/Legends|Female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] biologist and part of [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Ovolot Qail Uthan]]'s team of [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] who worked on a [[nanovirus]] made especially to decimate the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|clone army]]. She was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] [[Fi Skirata|Fi]] of [[Omega Squad]] using an [[E-Web heavy repeating blaster/Legends|E-Web]] blaster while trying to escape the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] base on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Qiilura/Legends|Qiilura]].
